name: AfterShip Post-Purchase
description: AfterShip Post-Purchase for Claude makes shipment and returns operations as easy as having a conversation. Effortlessly connect your AfterShip data and simply chat to search shipments, review delivery status, inspect tracking timelines, identify exceptions or overdue packages, look up specific orders, or review return and RMA details including refund progress, shipping status, returned items, outcomes, and related order information.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AfterShip Post-Purchase to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AfterShip Post-Purchase to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.aftership.com/post-purchase. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AfterShip Post-Purchase MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AfterShip Post-Purchase provides these MCP tools: get_return, get_shipment, list_returns, list_shipments, and list_tracking_filter_options.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AfterShip Post-Purchase?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AfterShip Post-Purchase in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does AfterShip Post-Purchase MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: AfterShip Post-Purchase requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AfterShip Post-Purchase is developed by AfterShip. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
